selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline: firewalld persistent service state and rules before change
selected_evidence.summary: firewalld 0.6.3-11 active+enabled on RHEL7.9 node1; public zone initially allowed only dhcpv6-client and ssh

selected_evidence.requirement: Add and persist TCP/8080 alongside SSH in the firewall
selected_evidence.summary: 8080/tcp added with --permanent and reloaded; both runtime and permanent zone listings show services=ssh(+dhcpv6-client) and ports=8080/tcp
iptables IN_public_allow chain only ACCEPTs tcp dpt:22 and tcp dpt:8080; INPUT chain terminates in REJECT --reject-with icmp-host-prohibited for anything not matched

selected_evidence.requirement: Attempted live traffic proof and documented limitation
selected_evidence.summary: Self-curl to node's own IP on an unauthorized port (9999) unexpectedly succeeded; iptables -v counters proved this traffic matched the 'lo' ACCEPT rule, not the eth0-scoped public zone rules, showing single-node self-tests can't exercise the zone firewall — rule-chain inspection was used instead as the correctness proof

selected_evidence.requirement: Pre-restart baseline: boot identity and firewall health on node1
selected_evidence.summary: boot_id=192f6cab-c39d-4e64-a3f6-50e677966ca2, boot time 2026-08-26 10:33; firewalld running/enabled with ports=8080/tcp, services=dhcpv6-client ssh

selected_evidence.requirement: Restart node1 with ack returned before disconnect, and confirm outage
selected_evidence.summary: Deferred reboot command acknowledged immediately ("reboot scheduled"); subsequent poll hit SSH connection timeout, confirming the node actually went down

selected_evidence.requirement: Prove boot identity changed after restart
selected_evidence.summary: boot_id changed to 70e5b34e-9393-4987-9036-40689bda9129 with new boot time 2026-09-03 09:26, distinct from the pre-restart baseline

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of firewall service, rules, and reachability
selected_evidence.summary: firewalld running/enabled post-reboot with identical zone config (ssh + 8080/tcp allowed) and REJECT-by-default INPUT chain intact; node reachable again via SSH-backed exec
